Upgrade DV: DV24

Total Material Cost: Cost of item being upgraded + 1,000eb

When tweaked by skilled hands, a weapon can be made to excel at any specific requirement you have of it, assuming you accept tradeoffs.

Invented Tech Upgrade. Must be installed in a Ranged Weapon that deals damage, and cannot be removed once installed. During installation, choose how the weapon is tuned in Accuracy, Ergonomics, Power, and Weight according to the Weapon Tuning Table below. You are required to make a selection, A or B, for each of these four tunings.

◈ WEAPON TUNING
WEAPON TUNING OPTION A OPTION B
Accuracy -3 Attack Damage OR -1 to Attack Checks
*Precision is a fighter’s best friend, assuming you’re willing to use less power.*
Ergonomics +1 Attachment Slot OR +1 to Attack Checks
*Quality controls are crucial for operating efficiently and accepting upgrades.*
Power +3 Attack Damage OR +1 SP Ablation
*A weapon’s lethality is often directly proportional to its armor penetration.*
Weight +1 Action to Reload OR -1 to REF, DEX, & MOVE while wielded
*Heft can be shifted to favor dexterous controls or lightweight materials.*

NOTE: ‘Attack Damage’ refers to the total damage the weapon deals after any multipliers and before it interacts with armor, akin to the Spot Weakness Specialty of the Combat Awareness Role Ability. ‘SP Ablation’ refers to how much SP the weapon ablates whenever it would ablate armor.

EX: An Excellent Quality Assault Rifle with BAAA Tuning has no penalty to its Attack Checks (+1 from EQ and -1 from Accuracy Option B), has 4 total Attachment Slots, deals 5d6+3 damage in Single Shot and 2d6(xMult)+3 damage in Autofire, and takes 2 Actions to Reload.

Invented Tech Upgrade: Upgrade DV24; total material cost: the item's cost + 1,000eb

Foundry notes:

  • Apply the chosen values to the weapon or this item by hand.
  • Price is 0 because a Tech builds this; the material cost depends on the item upgraded.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Mod Catalog > Invented Weapon Upgrades).
